messages:
Liam (docs): Heads-up: Java SDK 3.0.0 is released. Two important changes: 1) Maven/Gradle coordinates changed from `com.redwood:inference-java` -> `ai.redwood:inference`, 2) top-level package renamed from `com.redwood.inference` -> `ai.redwood.inference`. Both are breaking for in-repo imports and CI that pins the old coordinates. Migration guide: https://redwood.example.com/docs/sdk/java/migrate-3-0

Asha (eng-java): Why the rename? We consolidated package naming across languages and aligned artifact coordinates with the org rebrand. We also delivered smaller JARs using modular packaging.

Priyanka (product): This will definitely touch enterprise customers that vendor-lock build pipelines. What's the compatibility plan?

Asha (eng-java): Compatibility plan: published 3.0.0 with a thin compatibility artifact `com.redwood:inference-compat:3.0.0` that provides wrapper classes in the old package namespace delegating to the new impl. We will maintain the compat artifact for 90 days. After that we will deprecate the compat artifact with 60 days notice before removal. Server accepts requests regardless of client artifact.

Ben (build): CI note: examples/java-quickstarts and internal services using old imports fail during compilation on nightly with 3.0 enforced. I'll add a build matrix job that runs examples against both coordinates and fail only on the pinned `latest`. Also adding a Gradle/Maven snippet in the guide showing how to add the compat artifact as a temporary fix.

Liam (docs): Migration snippets for customers:

```gradle
// OLD
implementation 'com.redwood:inference:2.4.1'

// TEMP FIX (compat artifact)
implementation 'ai.redwood:inference:3.0.0'
implementation 'com.redwood:inference-compat:3.0.0' // maps old package names to new impl

// RECOMMENDED (update imports and remove compat)
implementation 'ai.redwood:inference:3.0.0'
```

```xml
<!-- Maven OLD -->
<dependency>
  <groupId>com.redwood</groupId>
  <artifactId>inference</artifactId>
  <version>2.4.1</version>
</dependency>

<!-- Maven RECOMMENDED -->
<dependency>
  <groupId>ai.redwood</groupId>
  <artifactId>inference</artifactId>
  <version>3.0.0</version>
</dependency>
```

Liam (docs): Quick Java import codemod example in the guide for common IDEs and a short sed command for CI:

```bash
# simple sed for linux/mac to update package imports
find . -name "*.java" -exec sed -i "s/com.redwood.inference/ai.redwood.inference/g" {} +
```

Asha (eng-java): Also added a small runtime compatibility header `X-Redwood-Client-Remap: true` for third-party libraries that read package names out of user agents; mostly internal but helpful for telemetry mapping.

Priyanka (product): Communications: 1) Console banner for all tenants tomorrow, 2) Targeted email to Java-heavy customers (>250k tokens/mo) with migration steps and compat artifact link, 3) Changelog + blog post on the rationale. Jordan (release) on cc for scheduling.

Ben (build): QA: examples failing now. QA-bot, please prioritize updating examples and tests to either pin the compat artifact or migrate imports.

QA-bot: Opening PRs in examples/java-quickstarts to pin `com.redwood:inference-compat:3.0.0` and to update a few imports. Also adding e2e that compiles against both 2.x and 3.x coordinates.

Liam (docs): docs-bot: changelog entry created -> https://redwood.example.com/changelog/java-3-0-artifact-rename

docs-bot: :white_check_mark: changelog updated by Liam (docs).

Asha (eng-java): Internal note: if any enterprise customer needs a longer runway, we can extend compat artifact maintenance per-tenant. Contact @Asha (eng-java) and @Priyanka (product).

Priyanka (product): Action checklist for docs team: 1) Publish migration guide + codemod (done), 2) Add compat artifact download and checksum to the guide (done), 3) Add FAQ about shading/relocation and how it affects reflection and serialization, 4) Schedule targeted emails (Jordan).

Liam (docs): Closing thread. Ping me or @Asha (eng-java) for tenant-specific migration assistance or if you need the one-line sed adapted for Windows.
